judgments.rewrite_hint: “A call seemed to come from an AI agent. But as the conversation went on, the voice was not AI at all.” Remove the specific “halfway” timing or narrow it to a general point during the call; MUSE-HC-006 confirms human-handled calls but gives no timing for the surprise.
“Mark Zuckerberg himself made some of the calls.” Delete this unsupported attribution; MUSE-HC-006 identifies trained human contract staff, not Zuckerberg.

“Workers read from a secret script to hide that they were human.” Delete the invented script and concealment claim; MUSE-HC-006 confirms human contract staff handled some calls but does not report this conduct.
“About 40% of Muse calls were made by humans.” Remove the unsupported percentage and state only that human staff handled some calls; MUSE-HC-006 gives no call-volume percentage.
“Meta said every call was fully AI.” Delete this unsupported attribution and claim; MUSE-HC-006 records that trained human contract staff handled some calls.
